Tourist Attractions

Travel Guide

📅

Best Time to Travel

Oct–Mar suits most of India. Hills: Apr–Jun. Beaches: Nov–Feb. Avoid heavy monsoon (Jul–Sep) in the south and west.

📍

How to Reach

Major cities have international airports. Most tourist towns connect by train, and long-distance buses link the rest.

🚆

Transportation

Flights for long distances, trains for comfort and value, taxis and autos locally, ferries in Goa, Kerala and Andaman.

🏨

Accommodation

Hostels and guesthouses, mid-range hotels, heritage palaces and homestays. Book early in peak season.

💵

Budget Categories

Economy: ₹1,500–2,500/day. Standard: ₹3,000–5,000/day. Luxury: ₹7,000+/day per person.

🎒

Things to Carry

ID proof, tickets, power bank, sunscreen, water bottle, basic medicines, comfortable shoes, weather-suitable clothes.

🛡️ Basic Safety Tips

  • Keep copies of your ID and tickets.
  • Use licensed taxis or trusted ride apps.
  • Drink bottled or purified water.
  • Keep valuables safe and avoid isolated places at night.
  • Share your itinerary with family.
